hero.estimateDefault: rough guide, gets better with every run
hero.allDoneHint: New footage shows up here as soon as the server has ingested it.

processor.cliMissing: The worker program cannot be started
processor.modelsMissingHint: Without the models only the technical steps run. Downloads are verified by checksum.

no_server.title: No server connected yet
no_server.fix: Connect this PC to your Rushbase server and you will see what there is to do right here.

not_enrolled.title: This PC is not enrolled yet
not_enrolled.fix: Get an enrollment token in the web UI under Processing and enter it in the setup.

server_unreachable.title: Server not reachable
server_unreachable.fix: Check the network and the server address in Settings.

mount.title: Library not mounted
mount.fix: The folder must contain the server's library (.rushbase/library.json).

options.title: Options
options.untilHint: Running jobs are handed back cleanly.
options.maxTempHint: Pauses above this value and resumes after cooling down. 0 = off.
options.idleOnly: Only while the PC is idle ({{minutes}} min)

run.waitingIdle: Waiting for the PC to be idle
run.waitingTemp: Paused: the GPU is cooling down

models.title: Download AI models
models.description: Downloads the models and programs that fit your hardware, verifies every file by SHA-256 and resumes interrupted downloads.
models.finished: All models are installed and verified.

library.search: Search, e.g. “boat in the harbour at night”
library.emptyText: Change the search or reset the filters.
library.offlineText: Search and filters come from the server. Processing works without it.
library.loginNeededText: Sign in once with your Rushbase account so the app may search.
library.noPlayback: Playback is not possible. Is the library mounted?

dragOff.wayland: Dragging out does not work on Wayland: use “Copy path” or “Show in file manager”.
dragOff.network_mount: Files on network drives are not dragged directly. Use “Send to Resolve” or the path.
dragOff.path_too_long: The path is too long to drag. Use the copied path.
dragOff.unknown: Dragging out is not available here.

basket.title: Selection ({{count}})
basket.empty: Nothing selected yet. Pick clips or single scenes in the library.
basket.resolveHint: “Send to Resolve” appears once DaVinci Resolve Studio is running with scripting set to “Local”. The exports always work.
basket.confirmText: The clips are imported into the open project “{{project}}”. Existing clips stay untouched.

server.title: Connect to the server
server.help: In the web UI open Processing, choose “Add a PC” and copy the command or the token here.
server.token: Enrollment token or the whole command
server.tokenHint: You can paste the “rushbase enroll --server … --token …” command as is.
server.name: Name of this PC

wizard.serverMissing: Please enter the server address and the token.

account.title: Sign in to Rushbase
account.help: For search and the library the app creates a personal access token once. The password is not stored.

library.title: Mount the library
library.help: Choose the folder under which the library is available on this PC (network drive or local).
library.hint: It must contain .rushbase/library.json. The app checks that it is the server's library.

wizard.mountFailed: The library does not match the server.

hardware.title: Models
hardware.missing_one: {{count}} model is still missing. Download it now or later on the Process page.
hardware.missing_other: {{count}} models are still missing. Download them now or later on the Process page.
hardware.complete: All models for this hardware are installed.

check.title: System check
check.help: Checks ffmpeg, ExifTool, library, server and data folder.
check.failed: The check could not be run.

settings.updaterHintOn: The app looks for signed updates on GitHub.
settings.updaterHintOff: This build has no update key. Download new versions manually.
